papers.title: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
papers.summary: Researchers propose a set-level reinforcement learning objective to train language models for diverse, high-quality, document-grounded idea generation, achieving stronger creative utility than larger proprietary models.

papers.title: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
papers.summary: Self-forcing training with teacher distillation and asymmetric conditioning stabilizes multi-turn image editing against accumulating distribution shifts.

papers.title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
papers.summary: CyberArena is a dynamic adversarial benchmark that evaluates AI agents through concurrent multi-round attack-and-defense combat in evolving environments, measuring capabilities via a dynamical scoring model.

papers.title: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Conditional Program compresses language-model embedding tables by reconstructing only requested rows via shared codes and local scales, reducing storage by 75% while improving fidelity.
